rationale: The previous candidate further reduced base_speed to 0.8, lowered kd to 0.5, and increased ki to 2.0 to improve stability and reduce stalling on the slalom track, but stalling persisted and steering oscillation remained moderately high. The evaluator feedback suggests continuing this cautious tuning by lowering base_speed to 0.7 to further reduce stalls, switching the line loss strategy from 'last_direction' to 'search_left' to actively steer the robot right when the line is lost, potentially improving recovery, and reducing kd to 0.3 to further dampen steering oscillations. I maintain ki at 2.0 to keep strong steady-state error correction, which helps reduce rms_error and line loss events. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged, as they have been stable and effective. I continue to request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to monitor improvements. I expect these changes to improve finish rates on the slalom track by reducing stalls and improving line recovery, lower steering oscillation for smoother control, and reduce line loss events and rms_error for better line following.
